name: s81coll_cfifo_crs4-c4a-COMMIT
purpose: hardened view of the _l4 frame column FIFO dsfd_cfifo_crs4 (per-lane landings, reset read epoch)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_cfifo_crs4 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-PINMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/land/dsfd_cfifo_crs4.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/land/ot_s81_land.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81coll_cfifo_crs4/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81coll_cfifo_crs4/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81coll_cfifo_crs4 --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_cfifo_crs4  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-DIE7/CRS4 10-18: NEW top dsfd_cfifo_crs4 (S81-LAND2 successor of the closed dsfd_cfifo_crs, member of every _l4 frame col_h9_l4 / col_h10_l4 / col_h9_MX_l4). Structural change vs s81coll_cfifo_crs: (1) the two column ingress blocks (ot_s81_static_column_ingress_hr + lane_cross_hr: xd on xf = xk[1], xd2 on xf2 = xk[2], 2-flop marker-sampled read epoch on cr_s, half-cycle h stage) are replaced by FOUR ot_s81_land rings (W 276, D 4), one per lane, each written on ITS OWN forwarded clock xk[k] and read on cr from the frame reset release (contract L1-L7, K = lk[3k+:3] identity strap); (2) ports: xd[565:0] / xd2[537:0] / xf / xf2 -> xl0..xl3[275:0] (same bits, same S positions) + xk[3:0] + lk[11:0] (W face); (3) CTS roots cr, cr_s, xk[0..3] (6; crs: cr, cr_s, xf, xf2). xa/xb/cc/x2 on cr and ri -> rr -> rd on cr_s are crs's. Same frame slot 280.8 x 69.12, same N face, same S data order (io_tcl derived from dsfd_cfifo_crs_nspread.tcl by physical/s81_die_pins/cfifo_crs4/mk_pins.py). The crs epoch-Gray hold hook (gray_hold.tcl) does not apply (no u_cross). No closed view of this top exists: first route.
